subject: [VolPred Alert][INFO] P5 vt-crowding-abm: K1261+K1262 evidence STRONG — 等用戶 confirm narrative reframe
body:
Alert level: info
Title: P5 vt-crowding-abm: K1261+K1262 evidence STRONG — 等用戶 confirm narrative reframe

P5 vt-crowding-abm paper portfolio status update — K1261 + K1262 雙 phase 完成，evidence STRONG，請用戶決定是否 reframe paper narrative。

## TL;DR
- K1261 Phase 1: 10,500 sims (132s) verdict H1+
- K1262 Phase 2: 16,800 sims (600s) verdict H1+ STRONGLY SUPPORTED
- 兩輪 independent code review (Codex CLI broken, fallback to feature-dev:code-reviewer) CONDITIONAL PASS, 0 CRITICAL bug
- P5-style (Sharpe-only) detector calibrates EXACTLY to VT=70% matching P5 paper Table 2
- 同 detector 下 TF=20%, MR=20%, NoiseControl=null — both 50% earlier threshold than VT
- 12/12 (scaling × window) cells: TF threshold < VT, MR threshold < VT — direction robust NOT knife-edge

## 結論 (research findings)
強 evidence「positive-feedback crowding 是 generic family，VT 是 representative case (largest AUM + real-world λ/γ amplification)」。Original P5 v2 verdict 撤回（NotebookLM portfolio meta-eval 認為 70% threshold = λ/γ 數學結果非 emergent）= partially rescued + extended：threshold IS positive-feedback emergent property, P5 不是製造臨界點，而是 representative case of generic mechanism。

## 用戶決定點 (policy decision required)
P5 paper rewrite to「positive-feedback crowding family」strongly supported. 等用戶 confirm 後，主線程開始 v3 rewrite (1-2 週 effort)：
- Abstract / intro 從「VT-specific crowding」改為「positive-feedback strategy crowding family，VT 為 representative case」
- §1 motivation 加 TF/MR 對照組描述
- §3 ABM specs 補 K1261/K1262 ablation 設計
- §4 results 補 Phase 1 + Phase 2 summary tables
- §5 discussion 對比 VT vs TF/MR threshold magnitudes

K1262b OAT (λ/γ ±50% sensitivity) 改 confirmatory not essential。

## Files
- experiments/k1261/k1261_phase1_verdict.md
- experiments/k1262/k1262_verdict.md
- experiments/k1262/k1262_threshold_matrix.md
- experiments/k1262/k1262_softer_detector_table.md
- knowledge.json item_id f1d85a74 (K1261) + f3b9edd4 (K1262)
- research_program.md P5 row: 🟢 STRONG

## Pending action (after 用戶 confirm)
回覆 confirmation: 「Yes, reframe to positive-feedback family」OR「Keep VT-specific framing」OR「Need K1262b λ/γ OAT first」
